item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('zoho_books_invoices_export.csv')
print(df['Status'].value_counts())
print(\"nulls:\", df['Balance'].isna().sum())

def to_num(s):
    return pd.to_numeric(s.astype(str).str.replace(r'[₹,"'$'"\\s]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')

df['balance'] = to_num(df['Balance'])
df['total'] = to_num(df['Total'])
df['due_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Due Date'], dayfirst=True)

today = pd.Timestamp('2026-08-23')
overdue = df[(df['Status'] == 'Overdue') | (df['due_date'] < today)]
result = overdue[overdue['balance'] > 0].sort_values('balance', ascending=False)
print(len(result), \"invoices overdue with balance > 0\")
pd.set_option('display.width', 250)
print(result[['Invoice Number','Customer Name','Due Date','Total','balance']].to_string(index=False))
EOF"
